meta.name: bowtie-benchmark
meta.description: Bowtie conversion benchmarks keyed to ACV band. Recreated from the Bowtie Standard (Winning by Design). Single source of truth for the bowtie-benchmark skill.
meta.units: All CR values are percentages. Cycle values are days.

bands.note: Band is selected by average new deal size (ACV) in USD, after discounts. Index 0 through 5.
bands.rule: band 0 if acv < 1000; band 1 if acv < 5000; band 2 if acv < 15000; band 3 if acv < 50000; band 4 if acv < 150000; band 5 otherwise

medians.note: Live-cohort medians, used when a metric has no ACV-keyed benchmark value (or the band value is null).

lower_is_better.note: Applies to sales cycle and discount.

scoring.neutral: No benchmark available for this metric at this band, or the value could not be parsed. Neutral metrics never count toward the ahead/near/behind tally.
scoring.cycle_parsing: Cycle benchmarks are ranges in days. Score against the midpoint: a range a-b scores against round((a+b)/2); '<10' scores against 10; '180+' scores against 180. If the user reports months, convert with days = round(months * 30.4).

derived.implied_nrr: CR7/100 * (1 + CR8/100) * 100. Only when both CR7 and CR8 are given and NRR is not.
derived.ten_year_base_multiple: (NRR/100)^10, the installed base multiple over 10 years before new logos.
derived.lead_to_won_yield: Product of the given values among CR1, CR2, CR3, CR4 (each /100), when 2 or more are given.
derived.expected_new_logos: leads * lead_to_won_yield, when a lead cohort size is given.
